evidence: Driven through the proxy on 2026-09-29 (tunnel egress from a US address). Every field was filled from vault tokens: first and last name, email, country, city, state, postal code and password. Enter on the Join button replaced the form with a page carrying a "Welcome" heading and a visible sign-out control, with the header's Sign in and Join links gone; no challenge, no error, no emailed-code step. The run report recorded identity, address, login_email and login_password fills. The account owner confirmed the registration mail at the registered mailbox the same day.
gotchas: The name inputs are Angular form controls: fill input[formcontrolname="firstName"] and input[formcontrolname="lastName"]. A selector on id or name substrings matches a different input on the page and leaves the real fields untouched and invalid.

Country/Region is a required select (select[formcontrolname*="country" i]:visible). Choosing a country then reveals city (input[formcontrolname*="city" i]), state (select[formcontrolname*="state" i]) and postal code (input[formcontrolname*="zip" i], input[formcontrolname*="postal" i]); all three are required. Fill them from the address tokens after the country.
Two consent checkboxes are required, in a separate form from the fields. Their inputs are hidden; click the styled checkbox elements (the snapshot refs) rather than the inputs.
The Join button is disabled until every control is valid, and once enabled it sits under the terms-and-conditions component, which intercepts clicks. Press Enter on the button instead.
A cookie banner (button "Continue") and a language prompt ("No") sit on the page at load; dismiss the banner before clicking anything.
Password rules: at least 8 characters with three of uppercase, lowercase, digit, special character. The vault's default 24-character password passes.
No emailed code at signup; the account is live on submit and the page lands signed in. The registration mail is the owner's to read.
notes: Discovered by scripts/signup-selectors.ts (session arm) on 2026-09-28; driven end to end through the proxy on 2026-09-29.
